issues: The product silhouette is not a single clean closed shape: the neck/cap area shows a stepped profile with a horizontal break, and the base edge is jagged rather than a smooth continuous curve.
The bottle body shows a faint horizontal seam line across the middle, and the glass highlight is broken into two disconnected patches instead of one continuous highlight.
The label text is not legible at the rendered size: the brand wordmark is blurred and the letterforms merge.

The lighting direction is inconsistent: the key light on the bottle comes from the upper left while the slate wall shows a diagonal sweep from the upper right, giving two conflicting light sources.

The top edge of the product is at 18% of canvas height, above the 10% minimum; do not shift a correctly positioned product.
The right edge of the product is at 88% of canvas width, inside the 5-95% margin; do not reposition a correctly placed product.
